query: Which imputation and sensitivity-analysis approaches are recommended when key index components have systematic missingness?

response.query: Which imputation and sensitivity-analysis approaches are recommended when key index components have systematic missingness?
response.answer: Recommended approaches include multiple imputation for systematic missingness and sensitivity analysis to assess robustness of results. Key techniques involve full information maximum likelihood and pattern mixture models. These methods ensure reliable data interpretation.
